title: [27/1/2024] Levels of post-school qualifications in Australia in 1999
prompt: The chart below shows the different levels of post-school qualifications in Australia and the proportion of men and women who held them in 1999. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The given bar chart gives information about the qualifications of Australian men and women in 1999.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, it is clear men dominated the two extremes of the educational spectrum, while women made up the majority of undergraduate qualification holders.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the first three qualifications, there was a stark contrast in the Skilled Vocational Diploma holders, with males accounting for approximately 90% compared to just 10% for females. By contrast, women comprised around 75% of those with Undergraduate Diplomas, nearly double the proportion of men at 35%. The gender distribution was more balanced for Bachelor's Degrees, though females still held a slight advantage at 50% versus 45% for males.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the remaining qualifications, men made up about 70% of Postgraduate Diploma holders, more than twice the percentage of women at 30%. Meanwhile, the gender gap narrowed for Master's Degrees, with males representing roughly 60% compared to 40% for females.
